title: extract-method
summary: Pulls a run of statements out of a routine into a new method
intro: Read this when a routine is too long and you want a run of statements moved into a new method without doing it by hand. Give the file, the first and last line and the new name; without --apply it is a dry run (exit 0, nothing written) and --json prints the edit set without writing. Exit 0 on a preview or an applied change, 1 when no edit is computed, 2 when the selection is refused or the arguments are incomplete; every refusal reason goes to stderr.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint extract-method --in <F> --from-line <L1> --to-line <L2> --name <N> [--json|--apply|--no-backup] - pull a statement run into a new method
help: drag-lint extract-method --in <F> --from-line <L1> --to-line <L2> --name <N> [--json|--apply|--no-backup]  - pull a statement run into a new method

steps: Select the statements to extract in the editor
Enter the new method name, review the dry-run preview, then apply; the unit reloads from disk

questions.ask: How do I move a run of statements into its own method?
Can I preview the extraction without changing the file?

notes: issued by the plugin from InvokeExtractMethod (DragLint.Plugin.Keyboard.pas)
